Changes made for clearer vocabulary

  • Fork (U+1F374): separate knife removed; fork centered and enlarged.
  • Plate (U+1F37D): utensils removed; plate centered and enlarged; fill lightened.
  • Bowl (U+1F963): spoon removed; bowl centered.

The cup is an original simple vector illustration created for Little Objects, also distributed under CC BY-SA 4.0. Other OpenMoji object illustrations are unchanged. No endorsement by OpenMoji is implied.
